name: smwmusic-island-ho-reboot
title: Island Ho! (Reboot)
description:
"Land Ho!" is an old maritime expression to indicate that, in the middle of a seemingly endless sea, land has finally been sighted. This is a play on words of that!

Rebooted with fuller orchestration and arpeggios a'la Kirby! Fun, quirky, exciting, and adventurous. Perfect for your overworld theme, short level, or a bonus area!
